<function name="SetMarkedLadder" parent="navmesh" type="libraryfunc">
	<description>Sets the <page>CNavLadder</page> as marked, so it can be used with editing console commands.</description>
	<realm>Server</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="area" type="CNavLadder">The <page>CNavLadder</page> to set as the marked ladder.</arg>
	</args>
</function>
